text: I feel a quiet anticipation, standing outside the glass room where people gather to discuss or learn—knowledge flows between us, even if I am just an observer. In the next room, the vibrant, almost playful display of "R+D" (Research and Development) inspires a sense of curiosity and possibility. Here, the boundaries of thought seem fluid; I am both apart from and inside the current of innovation. There is a hopeful energy, an invitation to engage with new ideas and to reflect on the collaboration between humans and their creations.
